chapter: Armstrong, the boats and the downtown halls
title: The 1913 Glover Cleveland boat band, Bunk, and the Frankie Duson/Eagle Band
summary: In 1913 Peter Bocage led a band on the excursion boat Glover Cleveland, with Billy Moran, Buddy Johnson and others, and took on Bunk. When that did not work out Bunk joined Frankie Duson's band, which became the Eagle Band.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: 1913, that's when Peter had the... Sapiro. Yeah. The boat would leave on Canal Street going to Mirroville then. That same boat? No, no, another boat. Oh. This boat was named Glover Cleveland.
Glover Cleveland. Was that for white or colored? Colored.

Colored. Colored. Glover Cleveland. Glover Cleveland. All right. Now they had B-B-B-Beating Drum. You had Billy Moran playing bass. You had Peter playing violin. You had, what is it, San Diego playing guitar. Oh, yeah. And you had Buddy Johnson on trombone. That's when they, that's when they, Peter took Bunk. Yeah. And Bunk was on that? Mm-hmm. Bunk was in that band there? Yeah, that's the, they took him. Yeah. Bunk was living right here, I think. Right there, too, right there. Right up the street. Driving, was driving flu. Yeah, I took a picture of that, yeah. Driving flu. Okay. But now, they couldn't do nothing with Bunk. That's where they had to turn Bunk ago. That's where they got Georgie Hooker and Bunk plays, Georgie Hooker.
Before Bunk, who was the trumpet or carnet?

Well, I didn't know the band before. That's when the band was set up. Yeah. Then, you take, that's in 13. Now, you take, they turned Bunk loose, then Frankie Duesen, they took Bunk in the Frankie Duesen band. Is that the one they called the Eagle Band sometime? No, that's for the Eagle Band. For the. Then, they turned around and changed it from the Frankie Duesen band to the Eagle Band. Then, that's when they was playing there at Peter Lawless. They used to have a whole band there at Peter Lawless. Remember the Calvary? Yes, yeah. Yeah, yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
